_what: What the one sharing tool (do-work/share-anything.mjs) keeps and says. A share is one workspace record at record_prefix + <label> in the sharer's own account: { reach: [{ type, id? | prefix? }], title, about?, can: ["view"], people: [{ principal, key_blake3, added_at }], published, revoked_at, expires_at, changed_at }. Each person, AI or link it is shared with gets its own key: token_prefix + 32 random bytes (base64url); only the BLAKE3 hex of that key is kept. The engine (trillion-rust src/account_rights/share-grant.json door_grant) reads exactly the reach of a record that names the presenter's digest now, so record_prefix and token_prefix here are the engine's, read from there when they change.

words.op: op is share, stop or access.
words.grant: grant is where this share is kept: {grant}.
words.thing: thing is one of: { type, id }, { list: <list id> }, { text, title? } or { items: [{ type, id? | prefix? }], title }.
words.can: A share only lets people view; can is ["view"].
words.until: until must be a future time (ISO), or left out for no end.
words.origin: origin must be a web address starting https://.
words.principal: A person or AI is named by 1 to {most} characters with no control characters; the name {link} is the link's.
words.who: Name who to share with, or ask for a link.
words.already: This is already shared with {principal}. Stop sharing with them first to give them a new key.
words.kept_failed: The share could not be kept after {tried} tries: another change to it kept getting in. Try again.
words.too_many: A share holds at most {most} people.
words.added_person: Shared {title} with {principal}. They can only view it, until you stop it.
words.added_link: Made a link to {title}. Anyone with it can only view it, until you stop it.
